title: "DAFSA: Finite-state structures for sequence data"
abstract: >-
  dafsa is a Python library for storing and querying sets of sequences as
  deterministic acyclic finite-state automata. It provides tries, minimal DAFSAs
  and their path-compacted form, suffix automata and CDAWGs for substring
  indexing, and acyclic weighted transducers, with weights defined over an
  explicit semiring.
